body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Sharp presented a thin-film LED solar panel battery ''Lumiwall'' at KES 2006. According to the company the solar panel Lumiwall with a single module performs power generation, daylight transmission and self-illumination functions.

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
